scope: Read-only first-party GitHub client serialization investigation; no TeX/source edits or browser-layout claim.

filename_resolution.method: Evaluate only isolated n.u filename resolver in Node vm, with empty context and1000ms timeout; do not execute whole GitHub client.
filename_resolution.initial_investigation_failure: The manually assembled URL omitted chunk- and returned404. That was a filename-reading error, not an unavailable-client boundary; correct resolver output returned200.

temporary_document.behavior: Creates a new HTMLDocument, opens it, writes an HTML body interpolating the existing element textContent, closes it, and reads that body textContent. This reparses HTML rather than assigning textContent.

tex_conversion.behavior: Reads the temporary-document body, trims exterior whitespace, removes leading/trailing one or two dollar delimiters, then calls tex2mml with display equal to the negation of isInline.

entity_findings.protected_inline: API raw &lt; becomes < in first parsed DOM text; temporary document reparses that entity into literal < text. The second decoding is established by actual client code.
entity_findings.display_caution: Some fenced displays use raw API <, which becomes literal < in first DOM text before document.write. A following letter can be interpreted as an HTML tag during the temporary-document parse. Exact browser/HTML parsing is required; applying html.unescape alone cannot reproduce this client behavior.
entity_findings.actual_browser_result: Not executed by this subagent; root owns replay/renderer evidence.

backslash_newline.client_behavior: No client slash-before-newline removal exists in the inspected functions. Dimension-argument safety clamping is a separate transformation and does not remove that slash.
backslash_newline.serialized_shape: Original two-backslash row separator immediately before physical newline becomes three backslashes plus newline in saved API HTML/DOM text.
backslash_newline.pinned_local_mathjax_interpretation: In3.2.2, GetCS sees a newline after the final slash, consumes it and returns a space control sequence; BaseMappings expands that sequence as text containing a space. The original two-backslash row separator survives. This preserves mathematical content/row structure in the relevant examples but can add visible spacing; it is not literal source equality.

primary_sources.mapping: space control sequence -> Macro with text-space replacement

backslash_newline.limit: This3.2.2 source reading is not a claim about GitHub deployed MathJax version. Actual API-derived payloads should undergo the established temporary-document parse and independent MathJax semantic replay.
